== Description ==
Hay Day - Maggie the Builder has arrived in Hay Day.

• Always wanted to customize your farm further? Now you can! The Builder will visit every week!
• Fully customize your farmhouse, your roadside shop and your truck based on 3 individual parts. 
How about flames decals on a yellow truck? A rainbow colored Roadside Shop roof? Or a new hay roof for your farm house? Endless possibilities await!
• Several new options every week! 
• Want suggestions? Check out the style book! Complete styles and get great rewards!
• Want to get them all? Get stickers for each option you try out, and complete your collection book!
